canDoYue: 你識喺行李轉盤報失、描述個袋、講行李牌號碼、填索償表，同埋要求送到酒店。
canDoEn: Report a missing bag at baggage claim, describe it, give the tag number, complete a claim form, and ask for delivery to your hotel.

dialogue.speaker: hugo
dialogue.text: My luggage is missing at baggage claim.
dialogue.glossYue: 我件行李喺行李轉盤唔見咗，條帶空空，因為個袋冇出嚟。
dialogue.say: My luggage is missing at baggage claim.

dialogue.speaker: opal
dialogue.text: Could you describe the missing bag for me, and tell me the colour if you remember it?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以講下唔見咗嗰個袋，仲記唔記得顏色？
dialogue.say: Could you describe the missing bag for me, and tell me the colour if you remember it?

dialogue.speaker: hugo
dialogue.text: It is a blue suitcase with a red ribbon.
dialogue.glossYue: 係一個藍色行李箱，有紅絲帶，底有兩個細轆。
dialogue.say: It is a blue suitcase with a red ribbon.

dialogue.speaker: opal
dialogue.text: What tag number is printed on your baggage receipt, so I can search for that bag?
dialogue.glossYue: 行李收據上面印住咩行李牌號碼，我可以幫你搵個袋？
dialogue.say: What tag number is printed on your baggage receipt, so I can search for that bag?

dialogue.speaker: hugo
dialogue.text: The tag number is HK four eight two.
dialogue.glossYue: 牌號係 HK four eight two，我可以喺呢張紙收據讀出嚟。
dialogue.say: The tag number is HK four eight two.

dialogue.speaker: opal
dialogue.text: Please complete this written claim form with me while the missing bag is still off the empty belt.
dialogue.glossYue: 個袋仲未上返空帶，請同我填呢張書面索償表。
dialogue.say: Please complete this written claim form with me while the missing bag is still off the empty belt.

dialogue.speaker: hugo
dialogue.text: Could you deliver the bag to my hotel if you find it after you finish this search?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果搵到，可唔可以送到我酒店？
dialogue.say: Could you deliver the bag to my hotel if you find it after you finish this search?

dialogue.speaker: opal
dialogue.text: We can deliver it straight to your hotel room after this long search is finished.
dialogue.glossYue: 搜完我哋可以直接送到你酒店房間。
dialogue.say: We can deliver it straight to your hotel room after this long search is finished.
